title: Linux build skeleton: workspace checks on Linux and CLI --version/--help run
description: Read .ralph/specs/linux-port/context.md and plan.md step 1. Move windows, windows-sys and retour under [target.'cfg(windows)'.dependencies]; cfg-gate the Windows-only modules in lib.rs and the .CRT$XLY callback, volatile read and Explorer/COM/comctl menu in main.rs; Linux stubs return clean errors with // LINUX-TODO: Phase C|D and never panic. Gate gpu runtime modules (adapter/agility/fence/texture/uma) and recomp dxc/pso/runner but keep rdna2/emit/dxbc/pack/shader/xbox/tiling. Add Linux log thread id and rpf atomic replace. On Linux xcl run prints "xcl run: not supported on Linux yet (Phase C)" and exits 2. Make tests/testgamedll and tests/testtitle check on a Linux host without breaking their Windows PE build (keep cargo build --workspace producing xcl_testtitle.exe on Windows). Acceptance, paste output: cargo check --workspace --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu ; cargo run -p xcl -- --version ; cargo run -p xcl -- --help ; cargo run -p xcl -- run /tmp/nope ; echo exit code ; cargo test -p xcl --lib with passed/failed/ignored counts. Format touched lines only, no whole-tree fmt, no unrelated refactors.

title: Linux platform leaves: XDG data root, /proc memory, thread id, ANSI fallback, atomic rename
description: Read plan.md step 2. Add Linux implementations and unit tests for: launcher data root precedence XCL_DATA_ROOT > XDG_DATA_HOME > $HOME/.local/share/XCL > temp (Windows keeps %LOCALAPPDATA%); host process private memory from /proc/self/status (document the field and units versus K32GetProcessMemoryInfo PrivateUsage); log thread id without windows-sys; util ANSI/UTF-8 fallback and under_wine false on unix; rpf atomic replace with std::fs::rename. Acceptance: cargo test -p xcl --lib with the new filters passing, cargo check --workspace --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, and the Windows cfg paths still compile (report if only checked by inspection because no Windows target is installed).

title: Phase B: xcl disasm and xcl rpf run on the real game files on Linux
description: Read plan.md step 3. Pick the smallest file in /run/media/anon/12TB_B/leonida-work/shaders/dxbc with ls -S and run xcl disasm on it and on one FSPX container; run xcl rpf on /run/media/anon/12TB_B/torrents/GTA6.Xbox.v1.0.2.1-CYBERLEEK/shaders.rpf with --top 20 and --probe. Fix only Linux blockers; do not change parsing semantics. Acceptance: paste the exact commands and the output shape (mnemonics, record counts, exit codes); strace -e openat -f shows no *.dll opens outside the game folder. Existing rpf/rdna2 tests still pass.

title: Phase B: xcl shaders stats and --recomp run on the retail corpus on Linux
description: Read plan.md step 4. Run xcl shaders on /run/media/anon/12TB_B/leonida-work/shaders and on a small sample (single file first), then --recomp over a small sample and, if fast enough, one sampled RPF scan. --compile N on Linux must print a clean "DXC is Windows-only; Phase D" error and exit 2, not panic. If any emitter file moves or is added, update TRANSLATOR_SOURCES in crates/xcl/build.rs in the same change. Acceptance: paste commands plus stage/instruction counts and timing; no panic; cargo test -p xcl --lib gpu::recomp:: passes with skips reported honestly.

title: Phase B: xcl inspect classifies the retail exe imports on Linux
description: Read plan.md step 5 and DEC-003. Extract the HLE route table (module names and DLL patterns) from hle::build so inspect can use it without implementation export tables or LoadLibrary. Console imports report their HLE module name; unimplemented functions report STUB, never HLE. Gate the resolver system leg on Linux with an explicit unavailable detail. Acceptance: cargo run -p xcl -- inspect /run/media/anon/12TB_B/torrents/GTA6.Xbox.v1.0.2.1-CYBERLEEK/game_scarlett_master.exe gives plausible header fields and import totals; --json parses; console imports detected; exit 0. Paste head of output and jq checks.

title: Phase C: PE loader maps images at their link address with mmap and MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE
description: Read plan.md step 6 and the loader, modules and pe modules fully. Replace VirtualAlloc/MapView with mmap MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE at ImageBase, per-section mprotect and madvise for large regions; keep relocations, imports by name/ordinal/delay, TLS directory and entry RVA semantics identical. An occupied address is a hard error naming the address; no silent base fallback. Acceptance: unit tests map a synthetic PE, reject a non-PE and reject an occupied base; a headless retail-exe map harness succeeds and is pasted. Report exact test counts and any skipped GPU/Windows tests.

title: Phase C: static TLS blocks and TLS callbacks on each Linux host thread
description: Read plan.md step 7. Allocate the static TLS block per thread manually and run the game TLS callbacks on thread start/exit by wrapping the host thread entry in the kernelx shim; do not interpose pthread_create. Keep TLS index and pointer semantics identical. Acceptance: a synthetic TLS test observes template 7 -> 8 on two threads; the test is deterministic and isolated; the testgamedll mw_tls_bump check is deferred to the cross-built e2e task. Paste test counts.

title: Phase C: VFS path mapping and copy-on-write overlay on Linux
description: Read .ralph/specs/linux-port/plan.md step 8 and vfs.rs plus vfs_hooks.rs fully. The clean-egret worktree already contains uncommitted Linux VFS work in vfs.rs, vfs_hooks_linux.rs, and lib.rs: review and finish it rather than overwriting it. Rebase GAME:, G: and D: read-only onto the game folder; S: and T: under the title data dir; implement copy-on-write overlay for writes. On Linux, hooks are linked-in libc shims on the host call path, not LD_PRELOAD. Keep Windows path parsing and existing mapping tables unchanged. Acceptance: cargo test -p xcl --lib vfs:: and cargo test -p xcl --lib vfs_hooks_linux:: pass; an overlay write is visible while a recursive hash of the game folder is unchanged; traversal such as G:\..\outside cannot escape the mount or address an arbitrary host file; an unmapped drive is rejected cleanly; cargo test -p xcl --lib and cargo check --workspace --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu pass. Paste exact commands and passed/failed/ignored counts.

title: Phase C: portable report core and sigaction crash handler on Linux
description: Read plan.md step 9 and eh.rs plus report.rs fully. Extract or add a portable report core so Linux can write report.json without Windows HLE/GPU statistic types. Install sigaction with SA_SIGINFO for SIGSEGV, SIGILL, SIGFPE and SIGBUS; record faulting PC, fault address, signal and mapped module. install_pc_hook is a logged no-op and no path claims C++ unwinding. Unsupported paths return Err with // LINUX-TODO: Phase C. Acceptance: a deliberate fault in a child process yields a report with the expected PC/address; no panic; existing report tests and cargo test -p xcl --lib pass; cargo check --workspace --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu passes. Paste exact commands and counts.

title: Phase C: Linux HLE registry and resolver preserve routes and safely stub imports
description: Read plan.md step 10a, hle/mod.rs, resolver.rs, stubs.rs, and DEC-002/DEC-009. Make hle_exports! cfg-dependent so Linux preserves export names with metadata address 0 and inspect classifies them as Stub. Build hle::registry on Linux with the same ordered routes as Windows and no LoadLibrary/GetProcAddress. The runtime resolver must allocate safe executable auto-stub thunks and write those addresses into the IAT; never write a null callable address. Keep real implementations out of this slice. Acceptance: focused registry/resolver/inspect tests pass; a synthetic imported call reaches a logged stub without a null call or panic; cargo test -p xcl --lib and cargo check --workspace --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu pass. Paste exact commands and counts.

title: Phase C: cross-build the test title and game DLL as PE and pass xcl run e2e on Linux
description: Read plan.md step 11 and DEC-004 after steps 9b and 10a-10e land. Choose and document a Windows target for tests/testtitle and tests/testgamedll (prefer x86_64-pc-windows-gnullvm, fall back to an available x86_64-pc-windows-gnu toolchain), install it if possible, build the PE and run the e2e through the Linux xcl run: every title check passes, the game folder is byte-identical, writes land in the overlay and the stub appears in report.json. Compile the integration-test surface with cargo test --workspace --no-run so Windows-only test imports cannot hide behind cargo check. If no PE target can link on this host, provide the exact failed commands as evidence and fall back to the synthetic PE tests; do not fake a pass. Acceptance: exact build/e2e commands with passed/failed/ignored counts.

title: Phase C: retail title smoke run reaches a stable first missing HLE
description: Read plan.md step 12. Run xcl run on /run/media/anon/12TB_B/torrents/GTA6.Xbox.v1.0.2.1-CYBERLEEK with a hard timeout and, if supported, XCL_RUN_SECONDS. Triage report.json and xcl.log; name the first stable missing HLE or unsupported import; fix the first one or two loader/kernelx items found and rerun. Acceptance: paste the command, timeout, the named failure and the before/after log lines; no hang past the timeout, and the game folder stays read-only.

title: Phase D: backend-neutral emitter plus GLSL 450 output for the known-good blit VS
description: Read plan.md step 13. Keep emit.rs semantics and push HLSL/DXIL specifics behind a backend module; add a GLSL 450 backend and translate the known-good blit VS class from the retail pack using XCL_SAMPLE_RPF (tests must no-op and pass when unset). External glslc is bring-up only. Acceptance: generated GLSL passes glslc -fshader-stage=vert and the position-output expectation test; paste commands and results. Do not shell out from the shipped path.

title: Phase D: in-process SPIR-V emission for the blit VS via rspirv
description: Read plan.md step 14. Add an in-process SPIR-V backend behind compile(compute_source) -> spirv_words using rspirv (verify its license is GPL-2.0-compatible before adding); no external compiler and no process spawn in the shipped path. Acceptance: SPIR-V words validate structurally and with spirv-val if available; the blit VS image matches the GLSL-backed result; paste evidence and the dependency license check.

title: Phase D: ash Vulkan compute runner executes kernel translations
description: Read plan.md step 15. Replace the D3D12 runner with ash compute dispatch, preserving the kernel ABI and the SKIPPED <test>: <reason> pattern when no Vulkan device exists. Acceptance: one instruction-semantics kernel and the blit VS produce expected output on a device; without a device the tests skip cleanly and the reason is printed. Report passed/failed/skipped exactly; a skip is not coverage.

title: Phase D: select 32/64-lane subgroup paths from Vulkan properties
description: Read plan.md step 16. Select the wave path from VkPhysicalDeviceSubgroupProperties::subgroupSize (VK_EXT_subgroup_size_control where available) and mirror the existing upper_lanes/x64_masks/mesh_wave split. Acceptance: a deterministic unit test forces both widths even when the device reports only one; no code assumes 64. Paste the test counts.

title: Phase D: console D3D12.X routes to a Vulkan backend and winit swapchain
description: Read plan.md step 17 and hle/d3d12x plus present.rs fully. Route console D3D12.X to a new hle/vulkan backend with null.rs as the headless fallback; implement present with a Vulkan swapchain and winit window while keeping frame pacing. Do not port real.rs or guard.rs internals. Acceptance: a windowed smoke shows a frame; the headless path still runs; paste the commands and the observed result, and say explicitly if the visual check could not be automated.

title: Phase E: XAudio2 decode sinks to cpal/ALSA
description: Read plan.md step 18. Keep the existing Opus/XMA decode and the XAudio2 vtable shape, target the game callbacks and sink to the default cpal device (MIT, static-musl friendly). Do not add cubeb. Acceptance: the test title audio checks pass without a Windows DLL; a device-less host returns a clean error, not a panic; paste commands and counts.

title: Phase E: GameInput and keyboard/mouse input via evdev with the unchanged mapping table
description: Read plan.md step 19. Map an evdev gamepad plus keyboard/mouse-as-gamepad into the existing gamepad state; keep the mapping table byte-for-byte identical to the Windows table. Acceptance: mapping unit tests unchanged (same bytes) and a fake evdev event produces the same pad state as the Windows path; paste evidence.

title: Phase E: XGameRuntime offline paths on XDG
description: Read plan.md step 20. Port users, saves, PLS and package offline paths to XDG_DATA_HOME / ~/.local/share/XCL with XCL_DATA_ROOT first; remove Win32 registry/path use on Linux. Acceptance: a save round-trip in a temporary XDG root passes; registry-dependent tests are gated or adapted; paste command and counts.

title: Phase F: static musl release-final build with size and corpus timing evidence
description: Read plan.md step 21. Install x86_64-unknown-linux-musl and a musl toolchain, add the release-final profile (opt-level=3, lto=fat, codegen-units=1, strip=symbols, debug=0, overflow-checks=false, panic=unwind), build the xcl binary and prove: file says statically linked, ldd says not a dynamic executable, no .so beside it, and the Phase B commands run from the musl binary. Report binary bytes and corpus timing before/after. Keep the bring-up profile available; do not hardcode target-cpu native.

title: Phase C: kernelx memory, threads, sync, and time on Linux
description: Read plan.md step 10b and the kernelx implementation plus tls_linux.rs. Port kernelx memory (mmap/mprotect), thread creation, synchronization, and monotonic time to Linux. All game threads must enter through tls::spawn so attach/callbacks/detach run; map Xbox priorities where permitted and degrade gracefully without CAP_SYS_NICE. Keep unrelated exports stubbed. Acceptance: focused kernelx and TLS tests prove memory protection, thread callback lifecycle, sync/time behavior, and graceful priority fallback; cargo test -p xcl --lib and cargo check --workspace --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu pass. Paste exact commands and passed/failed/ignored counts.

title: Phase C: kernelx file APIs and kernel-family fallbacks route through the Linux VFS
description: Read plan.md step 10c, kernelx file exports, ordinary kernel-family fallback APIs, vfs.rs, and vfs_hooks_linux.rs. Port the title-facing file operations needed by the test title onto the linked-in Linux VFS path and provide required libc-backed kernel-family fallbacks; do not use LD_PRELOAD or leave essential imports absent. Reads must see the read-only game layer, writes must land in the copy-on-write overlay, and S:/T: must use title data. Keep unrelated exports stubbed. Acceptance: focused tests cover read, overlay write, delete/whiteout, and an adversarial unmapped-drive or traversal path; a recursive source-game hash remains unchanged; cargo test -p xcl --lib and cargo check --workspace --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu pass. Paste exact commands and counts.

title: Phase C: DLL loading and host entry complete the Linux TLS lifecycle
description: Read plan.md step 10d, loader_linux.rs, tls_linux.rs, modules.rs, DEC-010, and the step-07 follow-ups. Serialize image/dependency loading; keep the strict MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE policy for now, so an occupied DLL base is a hard error rather than a silent relocation. Run DllMain and process TLS attach/detach callbacks in order; make run_main attach the calling thread and run process-attach callbacks before entering the EXE. For late DLL installs, record the installed-image count at each thread attach and never send DLL_THREAD_DETACH to a thread that did not attach to that image. Preallocate the per-thread TLS slot array (Windows uses 64 entries) before gameplay DLL loads so a late install cannot reallocate it under a live gs:[0x58] reader. Update stale loader/TLS comments. Acceptance: synthetic PE tests prove process attach/detach, main-thread TLS visibility, DLL callback order, occupied-base failure, late-install detach filtering, and stable preallocated slots; loader/TLS tests and cargo check --workspace --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu pass. Paste exact commands and counts; do not claim retail parity.

title: Phase C: execute an import-free synthetic PE through TLS and its entry point
description: Read plan.md step 9b, loader_linux.rs, tls_linux.rs, and DEC-008. Implement the first runnable image-code path: load_main, attach the calling thread, run process TLS callbacks, call the PE entry point, then run process/thread detach in the correct order. Use an import-free synthetic PE so no resolver or HLE behavior is faked. Acceptance: a synthetic entry returns a known value such as 0x2a; a TLS callback observes its per-thread template through gs:[0x58]; callback order and cleanup are tested; cargo test -p xcl --lib loader::, cargo test -p xcl --lib tls::, and cargo check --workspace --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu pass. Paste exact commands and counts; do not claim retail execution.

title: Phase C: Linux launcher and host make xcl run execute a synthetic title
description: Read plan.md step 10e plus launcher.rs, host.rs, preflight.rs, report.rs, config.rs, manifest.rs, and main.rs. Implement the Linux xcl run path: preflight/config/manifest/log/report setup, title data root, VFS initialization, and loader run_main entry. Keep Windows behavior unchanged and do not load Windows DLLs. Acceptance: a synthetic import-free game folder runs through the real CLI and records its known result; a missing folder and non-PE input fail cleanly; focused launcher/host tests, cargo test -p xcl --lib, and cargo check --workspace --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu pass. Paste exact commands, exit codes, and counts.

title: Phase C: kernel32 command-line and heap shims unblock mingw __getmainargs
description: After the step-11 CRT slice, the cross-built test title runs past __p__fmode but faults in crt_linux::strlen on a garbage pointer (gdb: s=0x534c5405006c6378) derived from the GetCommandLineW auto-stub returning null: mingw __getmainargs (exe+0x128f) parses the stub command line into argv, then strlen faults. Implement in hle/kernelx_linux.rs (or a focused twin): GetCommandLineW returning a real wide command line for the mapped exe plus game args, GetProcessHeap/HeapAlloc/HeapFree/HeapReAlloc backed by the libc heap, and GetModuleFileNameW for the mapped image. Keep extern win64, follow the existing handle/static patterns, add unit tests. Acceptance: the title no longer faults in strlen on startup args (__getmainargs completes); lib suite (now 228) still passes; workspace check and --no-run green; paste the new first-fault evidence (crash report pc/module+offset or next stub line).

title: Phase C: kernel32 FLS + std-handle shims unblock Rust TLS-guard init
description: After step-11b the cross-built title runs past __getmainargs/strlen but SIGSEGVs at xcl_testtitle.exe+0xae3e4 (fault 0x0, smashed stack) in the Rust std thread_local guard enable path: FlsAlloc stub returns 0 and FlsSetValue stub returns 0, so the guard takes its stderr-write failure path. Implement in hle/kernelx_linux.rs: FlsAlloc/FlsFree/FlsGetValue/FlsSetValue plus IsThreadAFiber/IsThreadAFiber-family, and the std-init neighbors the log shows (GetStdHandle, GetModuleHandleA/ExW, GetEnvironmentVariableW). Keep extern win64, follow the handle/static patterns, add unit tests. Acceptance: the title runs past the FLS guard (new first-fault evidence past +0xae3e4); lib suite still green; workspace check + --no-run green.

title: Phase C: kernel32 exception/console shims unblock Rust panic-report path
description: After step-11c (beb462d) the cross-built title runs past the FLS guard but SIGSEGVs at xcl_testtitle.exe+0x9b189 (fault 0x0, Rust __rustc::rust_panic int 29 after std stderr write_fmt). xcl.log shows 8 stubs: setvbuf, AddVectoredExceptionHandler, SetThreadStackGuarantee, GetProcAddress, GetConsoleMode, NtWriteFile, getenv, RaiseException. Implement in hle/kernelx_linux.rs (and crt_linux.rs for getenv/setvbuf): AddVectoredExceptionHandler/RemoveVectoredExceptionHandler, RaiseException, GetProcAddress, GetConsoleMode (+SetConsoleMode if trivial), SetThreadStackGuarantee, NtWriteFile console path, plus getenv/setvbuf neighbors. Keep extern win64, follow existing handle/static patterns, add unit tests. Acceptance: the title runs past +0x9b189 with new first-fault evidence; lib suite still green; workspace check + --no-run green.

title: Phase C: kernel32 timer/synch shims unblock the next title check
description: After step-11d the cross-built title runs its own checks (start banner, 2 TLS PASSes) then a check calls CreateWaitableTimerExW (stub NULL) and panics; _Unwind_RaiseException returns 5 (no .pdata unwinding yet). Implement in hle/kernelx_linux.rs: CreateWaitableTimerExW/SetWaitableTimer (+Cancel/CloseTimer via CloseHandle), WaitOnAddress/WakeByAddressAll/WakeByAddressSingle, and triage the argv FAIL (command line belongs to the game). Keep extern win64, follow handle/static patterns, add unit tests. Acceptance: the title runs past the timer panic with new first-fault evidence; lib suite still green; workspace check + --no-run green.

title: Phase C: .pdata parser plus RtlLookup/RtlPcToHeader/RtlVirtualUnwind shims unblock SEH search
description: Parse Windows x64 .pdata/.xdata from mapped images (RUNTIME_FUNCTION + UNWIND_INFO with PUSH_NONVOL/ALLOC_SMALL/LARGE/SET_FPREG, clean error otherwise). HLE RtlPcToFileHeader/RtlLookupFunctionEntry/RtlVirtualUnwind over mapped modules; RtlCaptureContext/RtlUnwindEx/RtlRestoreContext stay logged stubs. Acceptance: new pdata unit tests, cargo test -p xcl --lib, cargo check --workspace, cargo test --workspace --no-run green; title run still stops at the C++ catch_unwind check but Rtl* resolve as HLE and the report names the next fault past lookup.

title: Phase C: SEH dispatch (RaiseException + RtlUnwindEx/Restore/Capture) unblocks Rust catch_unwind
description: Implement real RtlCaptureContext (naked asm), RtlRestoreContext (naked asm), RtlUnwindEx dispatch loop, and RaiseException two-phase search/unwind calling guest personalities via RtlVirtualUnwind. Uses existing pdata parser (all ops in testtitle already covered). Acceptance: cargo test -p xcl --lib passes, cargo check --workspace green, testtitle run passes the C++-style exceptions check (catch_unwind) with no new regressions in earlier PASSes.

title: Phase C step-11h: ExitProcess/TerminateProcess terminate the Linux host with the title exit code
description: Implement kernelx_linux ExitProcess (never returns) + TerminateProcess for the current process via std::process::exit after writing report.json with exit_code, wire into exports + resolver/hle spot checks, verify title run exits with failures count instead of SIGILL. Out of scope: ExitThread, XMem/GPU/XGR stubs.

title: Phase C: xgameruntime identity shims unblock console-type and package checks on Linux
description: Implement Linux xgameruntime shims for XSystemGetDeviceType (7/6), XGameRuntimeInitialize(+WithOptions), XPackageIsPackagedProcess, XPackageGetCurrentProcessPackageIdentifier(+XPackageGetIdentifier), XSystemGetConsoleId/SandboxId so testtitle checks 5 and 26 pass. Wire as real addresses in hle_linux, extend resolver/hle tests, verify title run goes 10->12 PASS.

title: Phase C step-11j: XMem heap plus graphics and physical-page shims
description: Implement XMemAlloc/Free/Default alignment+zeroing, XMemVirtualAlloc UMA high-VA, and physical-page Allocate/Map/Free in kernelx_linux so title checks pass

title: Phase C step-11k: LoadLibrary family unblocks HLE and game-DLL dynamic probing
description: Implement LoadLibraryW/A/ExW/ExA + LoadPackagedLibrary + FreeLibrary + DisableThreadLibraryCalls in hle/kernelx_linux.rs via resolver::load_library (HLE pseudo-handles, mapped bases, game-DLL load path; NULL name fails ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER, miss fails ERROR_MOD_NOT_FOUND). Wire into exports + hle_linux/resolver_linux spot checks. Verify cargo test -p xcl --lib, cargo check --workspace, cargo test --workspace --no-run, and title run cuts modules + game-DLL failures.

title: Phase C step-11l: file reads past stubs (NtReadFile, GetFileInformationByHandle, CRT fopen/fread)
description: Implement NtReadFile + GetFileInformationByHandle(Ex) in kernelx_linux and fopen/fread/fclose/fflush in crt_linux via VFS so title file checks pass. Verify: cargo test -p xcl --lib, cargo check --workspace, inspect stubs drop, title run PASSes for console paths + CRT fopen + overlay writes + T: scratch. Retail smoke stays blocked on full e2e.

title: Phase C step-11m: user32 window shims unblock the top-level console window check
description: Implement Linux minuserx window slice (RegisterClassW/Ex, CreateWindowExW/A, GetWindowLongW, GetClientRect, DefWindowProcW, DestroyWindow, DwmGetWindowAttribute) as headless 1920x1080 cloaked frameless fakes so the testtitle user32 check passes. Wire into hle_linux registry, update resolver/hle spot checks, verify lib tests + title run goes 24->25 PASS.

title: Phase C step-11n: GameInputCreate headless gamepad unblocks GameInput timestamps on Linux
description: Minimal IGameInput COM (QI/AddRef/Release + GetCurrentTimestamp advancing) in gameinput_linux.rs so title GameInput check passes; wire into hle_linux + resolver tests.

title: Phase C step-11o: XTaskQueue manual/delayed/pool dispatch on Linux
description: XTaskQueueCreate/GetPort/CreateComposite/SubmitCallback/SubmitDelayed/Dispatch/Terminate/CloseHandle + XNetworking UDP port/connectivity + advapi32legacy LsaOpenPolicy so testtitle XTaskQueue checks pass on Linux

title: Phase C step-11p: XUser/XAsync/save/PLS on Linux
description: XUserAddAsync/AddResult/Gamertag/FindForDevice + XAsyncGetStatus + XGameSaveFilesGetFolder + PLS path so title XUser/storage checks pass on Linux

title: Phase C step-11p: XUser/XAsync/XGameSave/PLS slice unblocks title user+storage checks
description: Port Windows xasync + user/pls/save onto xtaskqueue_linux queues (ACTIVE map, begin_with fixups, offline user, token E_CANNOT_CONNECT when xbox_live_tokens off, PLS path via config pls_drive S:\ with statvfs quota). Wire into hle_linux + resolver_linux HLE lists. Acceptance: lib tests pass, inspect stubs drop, title run gains XUser + storage + PLS-drive PASSes with clean ExitProcess.

title: Phase C: headless XAudio2 engine unblocks title audio check
description: Implement xaudio2_linux.rs headless engine (XAudio2Create, mastering + XMA2/Opus/PCM source voices, Submit/Start/GetState with timed callbacks) so the test title XAudio2 check passes on Linux

title: Phase C step-11r: D3D12.X null device on Linux (queue+fence)
description: Port null.rs minimal device/queue/fence to d3d12x_linux.rs with win64 ABI; wire D3D12CreateDevice/XboxCreateDevice + serialize/blob into hle_linux; resolver HLE test; title queue_fence PASS

title: Phase C step-11s: D3DCompile + XG texture computer + console PlacedResourceX/PsoX acceptance on Linux null device
description: Linux: implement D3DCompile fake blob (d3dcompiler_47), win64 XGCreateTextureComputer/XGSuggestSwizzleMode via shared xg core, and d3d12x null-device console slots 44 PlacedResourceX / 55 DerivedX / 60 PsoX (+47/48/52/56/73/74/75 acceptance + DMA CopyBuffer memcpy). Verify: cargo test -p xcl --lib, cargo check --workspace, xcl inspect stub count, title run PASS delta.

title: Linux CRT forwarding for bundled game CRT DLLs
description: Route vcruntime140/msvcp140/concrt140/vcomp140/vccorlib140 to ucrtbase HLE so memcpy etc resolve to real code, never stubs or bundled GameDll. Verify with resolver unit tests.

title: Linux CRT string compare/search slice (strcmp/strncmp/wcscmp/strchr/memchr)
description: Bundled CRT DllMain/exe startup needs string compare/search via api-ms-win-crt-string and vcruntime/msvcp routes. Add strcmp/strncmp/wcscmp/wcsncmp/strchr/memchr to crt_linux with exports + unit tests + resolver forwarding checks. Acceptance: cargo test -p xcl --lib passes, new names resolve as Hle(ucrtbase) from bundled DLLs and string contracts.

title: step-12c CRT operator new/delete via ucrtbase HLE
description: Bundled vcruntime/msvcp operator new/delete (mangled ??2/??3/??_U/??_V + _callnewh/_set_new_handler) resolve to crt_linux malloc/free instead of NULL stubs; same fault class as memcpy. One commit, lib + workspace-no-run.

title: step-12d CRT terminate/EH slice
description: purecall/watson/terminate/unexpected/CxxThrow/FrameHandler via ucrtbase HLE + tests

title: Fix: clippy approx_constant TAU in dxil lowering
